Ingredients: 2 cups flattened rice, 1 onion finely chopped, 2 tbsp peanuts, 1 green chilli, 1/2 tsp mustard seeds, 1/2 tsp turmeric, curry leaves, salt, lemon juice, oil
Steps: Wash poha and drain excess water. Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add peanuts and roast. Add onion and chilli and saute until soft. Add turmeric and salt. Add poha and mix gently. Cook for 2 minutes. Switch off flame and add lemon juice. Serve hot.

Ingredients: 2 cups poha, 1 onion, peanuts, mustard seeds, turmeric, green chilli, curry leaves, salt, lemon
Steps: Wash poha. Heat oil, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, peanuts. Add onion and saute. Add turmeric and salt. Add poha and mix well. Cook 2 minutes and add lemon juice.

Ingredients: 1 cup rava, 1 onion, vegetables, mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger, salt, oil
Steps: Dry roast rava. Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add onion, ginger and vegetables. Add water and salt. When boiling, add rava slowly and stir. Cook until thick.

Ingredients: 2 cups rice, 1 cup urad dal, salt
